'''Green Squadron 3''' was an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighter was part of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], piloted by [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]. The fighter's canopy was modified to provide the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] great vision when flying through tight confines,<ref name="CCG-Green3" /> and had inlaid [[fijisi]] [[Wood/Legends|wood]] panelling. The latter modification led to Celchu suspecting it had been constructed on [[Cardooine/Legends|Cardooine]].<ref name="Bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

During the Battle of Endor, Green Squadron 3 was assigned to fly top cover for the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="CCG-Green3" /> Celchu flew the A-wing into the superstructure of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] alongside [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] before peeling off and returning to the surface in an effort to draw pursuit away from them.<ref name="Rogue">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
